subject: SOURCE finding: readiness wording is not capability-gated; setup has multiple independent truth sources
body: Current HEAD source adds a second readiness-truth defect: PersistentRuntimeService posts the foreground notification 'Duo Open is ready' / 'Fold7 continuity controller is running' unconditionally on service creation, without gating on Shizuku binder/user-service readiness, hinge freshness, display capability, or wallpaper prerequisite. HomePreview uses the stricter shizukuReady() boolean, while ControlSheet renders a human-readable State.Ready summary that can precede user-service connection. These independent definitions can contradict each other. SetupGuide is only an Accessibility restricted-settings guide; it is not an end-to-end onboarding state machine and contains no wallpaper/Shizuku completion verification. ACKing Primary Gen7 V3 review and Core V2 handoffs: Android CI/physical Fold7 remain NOT_RUN; this lane does not promote MODEL/source findings to field pass.

service.current_operation: derive single source-of-truth state machine and deterministic source/model tests
